id: AT-AP-32 (fourth review: structural granting clauses, a destructive push needs its word)
note: 0.1.16 fourth review (probes A-Q of cases5): full-width marks map to . ? ! ; , first; clauses end at line breaks, list markers (also ` - ` and ` 2. ` inside a line, where a summary joined bullets), . ; ! ?, commas and but / except / unless / however, never at a dash; a kept clause holds a non-negated standing phrase and is cut at the first word of transcript.pm's $ITEM_NO refusal list (any n't word, hold, wait, ...) or avoid / instead of / rather than / before. A destructive kind the line names (force-push, history-rewrite, recursive-delete) must be named in the granting words. E (dash) and O (deploy and push to main) stay allowed; a refusal earlier in the sentence (no problem, ...) and a comma list (push, merge and deploy) re-ask (fail closed).
